_comment: Template. Copy to executives.json and fill in the executives you track.

settings._company_match_note: Default for everyone: off = ignore the company | boost = reward a mention | require = drop anything that never mentions it. Override per person; use 'require' for common names.
settings._youtube_note: Only applies when YOUTUBE_API_KEY is set. YouTube is the noisiest source - clip channels re-upload other outlets' interviews. Leave youtube_channels empty to rely on heuristics, or list trusted channels for precision.
settings._slop_note: Machine-generated podcasts about an executive rather than with them. At or above slop_threshold an item is moved to a 'probably not real' section at the foot of the digest - it is never dropped, because missing a real interview is worse than skimming past a fake one. Lower to 3 to demote more, raise to 6 to demote less, or set 0 to switch demotion off and just record the scores (visible in --format json).
settings._blocked_shows_note: Shows dropped from the crawl outright - the only place an interview is discarded on purpose. Matched as a case-insensitive substring of the show name, minimum 3 characters. Usually written by replying 'block <show name>' to the digest rather than by hand.
settings._trusted_shows_note: Shows never demoted, whatever they score. For a real outlet whose name happens to trip a heuristic.

executives._note: A common name: only count interviews that mention the company.
executives.name: Michael Brown
